items.question: Which additional embodied female forms are included among those who know through devotion?
premises: The preceding verses enumerate female embodied forms who know through devotion on earth.
Ulukī and pecakī are named as further forms in this enumeration.
Sararī and gūlī are likewise included as alternative forms.
items.inference: The owl-woman, peacock-woman, sarari-woman, and guli-woman are also among the embodied forms possessing such knowledge.
uncertainties: The precise identity or species referent of sararī is unclear.
The precise identity or referent of gūlī is unclear.
items.plain_english: Likewise, the owl-woman or the peacock-woman, and indeed the sarari-woman or the guli-woman.
